summary: SpaceX completed its 700th Falcon series mission, successfully launching three telecommunications satellites into orbit. In defense and international developments, the United States and global partners finalized an updated multinational agreement to bolster secure communications. In civil space policy, a proposal for a U.S. Space Academy has drawn focus to the distinction between NASA operations and military space functions. In technological developments, NASA and IBM launched a new artificial intelligence model designed for lunar study. Internationally, Japan’s Hayabusa2 spacecraft achieved the first-ever laser ranging experiment with an asteroid. In planetary science, observations from the James Webb Space Telescope revealed that the rings surrounding the small body Chariklo are changing, while new research indicates Mercury contracted 40 percent more than its visible surface scars suggest. Skywatchers can look to the horizon tonight to observe Venus shining beside the crescent moon at sunset.
